Hi Nina / SylverCloud AP team,

Attaching Invoice_2026-07-31 for services delivered in July (PO: PO-8891). Can you confirm expected remit date and whether you'll pay via ACH or wire? We can accommodate split payments if treasury requires — please indicate the first payment date and any internal reference we should include on the remittance (PO + invoice number preferred).

Also attaching our W‑9 for vendor onboarding; if you need a different tax form for your AP intake, let me know and I’ll route it to Finance.

Attachments: [Invoice_2026-07-31.pdf (PDF, 142 KB)], [W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (PDF, 90 KB)]

Quick asks:
- Confirm ACH vs wire and remit-to details
- If splitting payment, confirm amounts/dates (we typically map partials to the invoice using PO+invoice)
- Any additional vendor paperwork needed to push payment to next treasury cycle?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Invoice 2026-07-31 — payment schedule confirmation & tax handoff

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the invoice and W‑9. A couple of items from our side before we lock dates:

1) Treasury is asking for a vendor onboarding form completed with our supplier classification and TIN for their records — I’ve attached our standard form; please complete section A and return.
2) We need the invoice to explicitly state whether any VAT was charged (this is for our AP validation). If VAT is not applicable, please include an explicit line "VAT: 0.00 (not applicable)" on the invoice copy you sent.
3) Our treasury cutoffs this month are Sep 7 (ACH) and Sep 14 (final wire window). We anticipate being able to split this invoice: 50% via ACH on Sep 7 and the remaining 50% via wire on Sep 14 — can you confirm you’ll accept that split and that the PO mapping will be preserved?

If you can return the completed vendor form and updated invoice (VAT line), I’ll schedule the Sep 7 ACH and share a remittance stub.

Thanks,
Nina Rao
AP & Treasury Operations
SylverCloud
Attachments: [vendor-onboarding-form_SylverCloud.pdf (PDF, 68 KB)]

Hi Nina,

Thanks — we've completed and attached the vendor onboarding form and updated the invoice to include the VAT line you requested (VAT: 0.00 — not applicable). We can accept the split as proposed: 50% ACH on Sep 7 and 50% wire on Sep 14. Please confirm the exact payment references you will place on each remittance (we ask for "PO-8891 / INV-2026-07-31" so our AP can auto-apply).

Notes and attachments:
- Completed vendor-onboarding-form_SylverCloud.pdf (filled)
- Updated_Invoice_2026-07-31_v2.pdf (with VAT line; maps to Invoice_2026-07-31)
- W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (we re-attached for your records)

If treasury needs bank details for the wire, we prefer to share those via a secure portal — I’m including a link below to the finance folder and copying Priyom (payments) so he can confirm access to bank details if needed.

Secure link to bank details: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_secure_finance

Priyom — can you please stand by to provide the wire instructions via the portal if SylverCloud requests them?

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Once we have your confirmation on references I’ll update our ledger and expect the Sep 7 ACH remittance stub.

Best,
Monica Patel
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
